# Overrides for semgrep's exact pins that carry known vulnerabilities
# (Dependabot alerts on .github/requirements/semgrep.txt). semgrep 1.184.0 still pins
# mcp==1.29.0 (CVE-2026-59951, CVE-2026-116684/5/6; fixed in 1.30.0) and the
# OpenTelemetry family ~=1.37.0 (opentelemetry-api CVE-2026-114603; fixed in 1.45.1).
# The OpenTelemetry packages move together: api, sdk and exporters share a version,
# and the instrumentation packages use the matching 0.(minor+21)b0 release.
# Used by: uv pip compile --override (see the header of semgrep.txt).
mcp>=1.30.0,<2
opentelemetry-api>=1.45.1,<1.46
opentelemetry-sdk>=1.45.1,<1.46
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http>=1.45.1,<1.46
